column3: This is highway unit! Target heading my way and not stopping! Engage and neutralize the target! Don't let him through!
Target is approaching on highway. Intercept and neutralize! Roger that.
Highway unit to base. Target inbound. Adjust your position and engage!
Highway unit 12, you are to intercept your target at all costs. Roger that. I'll move and shoot. Over.
Highway unit to base. Explosives are ready to detonate. Destroy that vehicle! Over!
Base to Bomb Unit 5, you must stop this vehicle. Explosives are in place! Target is coming!
Sir, I'm in position. Explosives are a go. Blow him up, soldier! Will do.
Base to B unit, are you done setting up the charges? Yes, sir! I can see the target! I'm ready!
Unit 7 to Base. I'm behind cover and awaiting target. Proceed with caution. Don't let him see you.
Sir, the target can't see me. I'm about to engage. Roger that. Use the element of surprise. Over.
Base to highway units, stay hidden. Prepare to engage. Affirmative. Target is approaching.
Sir, he's coming! What are your orders? Stay behind cover. Engage as he passes. Got it!
Update on highway target requested. Spike strip deployed. Target approaching. Roger that. You must stop this vehicle.
Sir, spikes are ready! Roger that! Stop your target!
Spikes unit to base. Target coming my way. Blow his tires! Stop him! Over!
Highway unit 9. Is the spike strip deployed? Yes, sir! Target is approaching! You must stop that car, soldier! Yes, sir!
Target is in my sights! Your orders are to shoot him down!
Target is heading my way! Shoot that bastard!
Here he comes! Light 'em up!
I see him! Shoot that bastard!
Target in sight. Orders? What do you think?! KILL HIM!
Dispatch, give me a report on the highway checkpoint points. All highway units are in position. Traffic has stopped and the city exits are secured. Roger that. Over.

Phantom Eagle to Base, approaching the drop zone. Roger that. Unit 16 to Base! We're currently holed up in the shopping mall. Can we get a transport out of here? Unit 16. Your transport will be there in. five minutes. Just keep those people safe until then. Sir, there's a lot of civilian and personnel on the ground in the city. We can't do this. We can and we are gonna do this. If this virus or whatever it is spreads, we could lose the whole country. The entire world! They will be a fair sacrifice. Over. Checkpoint 9 to Base! We missed our transport and are heading to the Iache River on foot. We'll be there in about ten minutes. Good man. You make me proud. Carry on. Phantom Eagle to Base, target in sight. God forgive us.

Sherman to Phantom Eagle. We have the President's approval. You are go for the drop. I repeat, you are go for the drop. Affirmative. Nuclear head armed, ready to drop. Heading to target, over. Sir, all transports are on ground. We're evacuating the riverbank. Roger that. Do it fast. We're pulling out, now.

Checkpoint to Base! We're unable to stop our target! It's continuing its run on Highway 65! You couldn't stop a single car. Give me a visual report! Sorry, sir. We're low on personnel here. The target is driving a black sports car with tinted glass. The driver's visual is still unknown. To all checkpoints on Highway 65, we have a moving black sports car. It must be stopped! Stay alert. Outpost 7 to Base! We're facing a massive crowd of undead here! We're holding but we might have to pull back if more show up! Maintain your position. They're dead and slow for Christ's sake. Just kill 'em all! They're hard to kill, sir! Just do your job. Yes, sir!
Checkpoint to base! We have a moving vehicle headed our way! Neutralize the vehicle! The driver could be infected or even dead for all we know! Roger that!

Checkpoint to Base. Uh... the target is still going. Are you kidding me?! Maintain your position. The next checkpoint will handle him. To all ground troops on Highway 65, you are to intercept and shoot down the target. Over. Outpost 10. I need a sit rep. We're holding, but damn, there's a lot of them. Hold on. There's a LOT of them! We're almost surrounded! If they cover our east front, we're in trouble! Hang in there. Outpost 7, what's your status? We were overrun minutes ago. We're still on the move to South Square Park to make stand there. We're killing them, but more keep coming! Roger that. Don't lose South Square Park. Over.
Checkpoint to base. We confirm a black car coming our way. Orders are to take him out? Affirmative.

Target has been identified as John Creasman, a local mechanic. Has a prior history of disorderly conduct. Nothing special. He's a freaking nobody. He's obviously trying to reach the tunnel to exit the city. We can't let that happen. Nobody gets out of the quarantined area. Base to Highway 65 personnel. Use spike strips to stop him. Over.
Sir, the target is approaching. We have a visual on his front plate. Sending the data your way. Over. Data received. Over.

Uh, it's a negative, sir. Target's still going. This is a bad joke! Damn it! Base to Hellfire. Change your course and head towards Highway 65. We have a civilian on the run. He must be stopped. Affirmative. Heading towards Highway 65 now. Over. To all highway units, dispatch some men behind cars and try using the element of surprise to stop the target. Sir, we have reports that 12 of our forward posts were completely overrun in the last 10 minutes. Where are the troops now? Scattered. Trying to regroup, sir. Damn it. Uh, have them fall back and, uh, regroup northwest near the Brighton Bridge. Yes, sir.
Base to Checkpoint 4! Stop this prick, will ya?! We'll try, sir!

Sir, our fences are down! Zombies are marching in! I can't! We can't hold them! Hey, watch out behind! Come in, Checkpoint 5. Checkpoint 5. Shit. Base to Highway 65 units. Bring in the bomb squads. If this John Creasman gets out, this could mean a statewide epidemic. We have to stop him. Yes, sir! He's not the first jackass to try to get out. We'll blow him to pieces. Over. Unit 11 to base! Brighton Bridge is completely overrun! We need a new fallback position, now! Uh, set up a defense at the Chinatown Plaza! Sir? We just came from there! Uh, goddammit! Just move north! Just move freaking north! Yes, sir!

Checkpoint 5 to Base! We have a problem here! We're facing a lot of deadheads. Our fences are holding but if that Creasman guy runs them over, we're in deep shit! It's your job to stop this freaking car, soldier! Do not let him pass! Do not let the zombies through! You hear me? Uh, yes! Yes, sir!

Attention, all troops. This is General Sherman. I am taking command of this operation. We're facing an enemy like we've never seen before. But keep your heads cool, and we're gonna get through. Now follow my orders carefully. All ground personnel are to converge to a defensive line along the Iache River. Our backs to the water, we'll make a final stand, in one single direction. We also have reports that some zombies have mutated. Be aware they are very strong and should be avoided at all costs.

Checkpoint to Base! We're in trouble here! We need orders! Maintain current strategy. We're about to be overrun. Current strategy is shit! I repeat, maintain current strategy. What?! What the hell is going on?!

Checkpoint 7 to base. The target has gone beyond our checkpoint, but now we're overrun by zombies! We're moving out! Fall back to the Iache River with the other units. Now! Yes, sir! General Sherman to air support. Head over to Highway 65 for a carpet bombing on the target's location. Roger that. Unit 5 to base. We're currently sieged by a huge crowd of zombies. We'll try to circle around the river, but we've lost a lot of men. Unit 5, don't fight them. Just get your ass to the river. ASAP. Yes, sir.
Checkpoint 7 to Base. We have the highway target approaching. What are your orders? Let him through. Sir? Let. Him. Through. I have a surprise for him. Yes, sir!

Sir, he got through. Sorry, sir. It's okay, son. To all Highway 65 personnel, prepare for a pullout. Sherman to Dispatch, send transports to all the highway checkpoints. Yes, sir. Hellfire units, arm your air-to-ground missiles and keep pursuing the target. Over. Affirmative.
Sherman to Checkpoint 8, you are our last ground effort to stop John Creasman. Do your greatest. Sir, yes sir!

Dispatch, send all transport choppers to the Iache River bank. We're evacuating the area. Yes, sir. Phantom Eagle, what is your position? Phantom Eagle to base, I'm currently at 64.7 and 32.4, heading to 79, over. Roger that. Maintain current course, over. Sir, we're at the Iache River. There are literally millions of zed heads slowly coming our way, but we're holding up for now. I see the transports coming. Hold position, and don't start evacuating until all the transports have landed. We'll need a synchronized retreat. Yes, sir!

General, sir, we're going to try and stop Creasman. What the hell are you still doing there? We're pulling out! Sir, we'll complete the mission. Good man. Do it and then get your ass to the Iache River ASAP! Sir, yes sir!
We're taking heavy losses at the West Ridge! We're sending backup right away. What's your exact position? Uh... G32, E51! Roger that, sending backup now!
Base is secure. Requesting orders. Maintain position.
Base to 4-Base-Delta. Relocate south front. Roger that! Relocating now!
Unit 8 to Base! We need artillery fire on Northside Park now! Negative, Unit 8. Our artillery has been proven ineffective against the undead. Maintain current strategy.

WE HAVE HUNDREDS OF CIVILIANS REQUESTING TO LEAVE THE CHECKPOINT! PERMISSION TO- Permission denied. Secure position, no one gets out. BUT SIR! THE HORDES ARE CLOSING IN AND- Oh, God! Secure the position! No one leaves, you understand? Your orders are to neutralize the civilians! YES SIR! FIRE! FIRE!
Unit 4, you are to begin neutralizing civilians at your checkpoint. Over. Orders received.
Unit 10 to Base! We're surrounded on the East Site factory! Requesting airlift out! Over! Denied. Secure position and await orders. Requesting airlift ASAP! THEY'RE GETTING IN WE-!
Approaching area Delta Tango. The rabbit is almost in the hole. Are you out of your mind? Forget the freaking codes, son! We're fighting dead people. Uh, sorry, sir.

We need backup! This is Unit 12 on Burgony Street! Our humvee has turned over to our- we're surrounded! Agh! Shit! Please repeat that, Unit 12! What is your position? Oh my god! Ah, shit! They're attracted out on me-! Unit 12! Unit 12! Please respond!
This is Unit 9! We have a bitten civilian, requesting aid! Permission to assist! Denied. Neutralize civilian and burn the corpse, over. Orders received.
Highway sweep's in progress. Spike strips have been installed, all traffic has been stopped. Roger that. Carry on!
Yeah! Light those fuckers up! Woo! Nice shooting! Cut the chatter.

Base to Phantom Eagle. Is the load ready and hot for a drop? Phantom Eagle to Base. Affirmative. Circling the city, awaiting the order. Let's pray we don't need to give this order. Over. Affirmative. Over.

Central Plaza is completely overrun! We need to pull back everybody! Pull back from Central, now! Denied! You are to hold position! They're killing everyone! It's all over! We've lost Central, I repeat, we have lost Central!

Road Unit 3, why aren't you at your position yet? The road is filled with debris and vehicles. We're having problems getting the convoy through. Get your ass to your designated position ASAP! Sir, yes sir!
This is Unit 17! The zeds are spilling through the barricades! Our position is completely compromised! Over! Pull back to Sector 11. And hold position, Unit 17. Orders received! We are pulling back!
Unit 5, we need a status report. There's a lot of them, but- but we're holding! Keep me posted. Will do!
Initiating carpet bombing on all designated targets. Over. Acknowledged.
Base to Air Unit 6, visual feed requested. Visual feed going online in 3, 2, 1. Visual feed is up. Over. Data received. Over.
This is Unit 19 on Rikers Street, requesting new supplies. There's too many of them! Request received, Unit 19. Supplies are en route.
This is Hellfire. My chopper is heavily damaged. I must abort. Return to base immediately. Over.
Hellfire to base! We've taken heavy damage! Retreating for emergency landing! Roger that. Proceed to east side base.
Base to Hellfire. Engage target. Take him down! Roger that. Engaging target.
This is Hellfire. I've spotted the target heading up Highway 65. Permission to engage the target. Over. Permission granted. Engage the target. Over.
Hellfire to base! I request permission to use air-to-ground missiles! Granted. Over.
Base to Hellfire, take the target down now! You have permission to use air-to-ground missiles. Affirmative. Over.
This is futile! Your escape attempt will get you killed!
YOU CANNOT EXIT THE CITY!
Stop, or your vehicle will be destroyed!
Stop or your vehicle will be destroyed!
Stop now! This is a matter of national security!
There's no way out. Stop and surrender!
STOP YOUR CAR NOW!
The city is quarantined. You can't leave.
Stop your vehicle immediately!

This is air support approaching drop zone. Permission to engage. Over. Permission granted. Engage.
Target hit, but not neutralized. Roger that. Return to base for refueling.
It's a hit! It's a hit! Target is still going though. That should slow him down. Let the ground units handle the rest. Return to base.
Target missed. I repeat, target missed. I'm. out of ammo. Dammit! Return to base. Over.

That's a miss. Target still going. Circle around and hit him again. Roger that.
